$description: Tooltip's tokens (plan 0006 §0s). The build generates styles/components/kinds/tooltip.css and tooltip.generated.ts from the tooltip group.

tooltip.$description: Styles the content bubble. Each variant is a surface role read from the family in scope; the old presets map to: default → elevated; glass → glass + deep; stark → stark + glow; flat → flat + minimal; matte → neuro + solid. The kind owns its radius and label size (the class map's rounded-md and text-sm); padding and position stay as layout.
